'''Iqoon''' was the third and outermost<ref name="CE" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Roon (star)|Roon]] in the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]], hidden within the dense [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and debris cloud commonly referred to as the [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|Cloak of the Sith]],<ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Iqoon was a barren rock with two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" /><ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]], except [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'';<ref name="GW" /> however, an excerpt from the sourcebook was published as a promotional preview on the official [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, [[Wizards.com]], a pair of weeks before the book's release.<ref name="WR">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040311roon|text=Roon: ''Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds'' Excerpt 4}}</ref> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Roon star system in grid square S-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
